real: M2A2 Bradley (unit_sheet: 2A42 / Bushmaster-class 30 mm, PKT / M240 coax, BGM-71 TOW-2 twin launcher)
shape: unit_sheet.json Phương tiện: six road wheels, a hull taller than a tank's, the turret set off to the left with a short 30 mm gun and the TOW box on the turret's side, a big rear ramp; from above a rectangle with the square missile box at the turret's side; about 5.2 x 2.9 x 2.4 m (0.8 x the real M2 Bradley); team stripes on the roof and both sides; no real insignia.
confidence: xấp xỉ (M2A2 published dimensions and layout)

features.feature: the tall box hull (Team): steep upper glacis, lower nose plate, the lower hull
driver's hatch and periscopes front left, engine grilles front right, exhaust louvre on the right side
the rear ramp with its door, hinges, handle, tail lamps
six road wheels, front sprocket, rear idler on its arm, a linked track
bolted armour skirts (four panels a side) with a rubber lower edge
the turret set off to the left, spaced armour on its cheeks, the mantlet, the 30 mm gun and its brake, the coax
the twin TOW launcher box on its arm on the turret's left cheek (raised by the runtime)
the gunner's sight head, the commander's viewer, two hatches, three-tube smoke launchers on both front corners
the commander's pintle M240 on a post (MODEL_STANDARD 'Roof guns')
the turret's rear stowage basket with bags and a rolled tarp; stowage boxes, water cans, fenders, lamps, tow hooks, Team bands
